Italian Football Trophies Collection – Ultra Realistic 3D Pack features a premium selection of Italian-style league and competition trophies designed for sports broadcasts, game cinematics, promotional content, and presentation scenes. Each model is built with clean topology, realistic proportions, and high-quality metallic materials to ensure strong reflections and professional visual impact in both close-up renders and wide showcase environments.
This pack contains:

  - Serie A

  - Coppa Italia

  - SuperCoppa Italiana

  - Serie B

  - Serie C

  - Coppa Federale

These models are ideal for stadium scenes, sports branding visuals, award ceremonies, and football-themed projects requiring authentic Italian competition-style trophies. Perfect for game developers, motion designers, and 3D artists looking for realistic and production-ready football silverware assets.

description_text:
The life size version is split into multiple parts to fit 256X256 mm print beds.
 It doesn't fit in the A1 mini bed. It's split it three parts: base, statue and globe. 
There are no mid-statue seams as in other similar models.

AMs is not necessary. Manual filament changes supported via pre-inserted pause points.
 I recommend using PLA Silk filament and dropping printing speed to 50% to achieve smooth and glossy surface.
Glue recommended for final assembly of the life size version

description_text:
Description:
High-quality, detailed 3D model of the iconic Adidas Jabulani Official Match Ball, used during the 2010 FIFA World Cup in South Africa.
This model has been accurately crafted in Blender to match the unique 8-panel spherical geometry, seamless surface design, and vibrant traditional South African color accents of the original match ball. Perfect for photorealistic renders, sports visualizations, animations, commercial projects, and real-time game engines.
Key Features:Accurate Geometry: Clean and optimized mesh based on the real-world dimensions and iconic panel layout of the Jabulani ball.
High-Resolution Textures: Includes crisp, high-detail texture maps for close-up renders.
PBR Ready: Surface textures configured for realistic light reflections, subtle gloss, and leather-like roughness.
Game & Render Optimized: Well-balanced polycount suitable for smooth performance in Unreal Engine, Unity, and offline rendering (Cycles / Eevee / V-Ray).
Clean UV Unwrapping: Non-overlapping UV layout ensures no texture stretching or seams issues.
Included File Formats:.blend (Native Blender project file with materials applied)
.fbx (Universal 3D exchange format)
.obj + .mtl (Wavefront standard format)
.gltf / .glb (Ideal for web, AR, and real-time platforms)
Technical Specifications:Object Type: Soccer / Football Match Ball

description_text:
This 3D model was originally created with Sketchup 8 and then converted to all other 3D formats. Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00
The three residential highrises - 'Rudo' buildings or the Eastern gate of Belgrade are one of the most renowned buildings of the communist architecture in Yugoslavia. Built in 1976. on the hill, they mark the entrance to Belgrade from the Nis highway and the whole 'Konjarnik' residential neighborhood. With height of ~85m and 90m when looked from the lower level, they are among the tallest buildings in Belgrade and whole Balkans and with population of cca 500 each they are also among the most populated buildings in Balkans.

description_text:
Hey all! 
This is a clean mesh I've recently finished! It's fairly low poly looking despite having 40,000 + vertices, and is modeled after a real place (https://www.google.com/maps/@46.7868482,-92.0983326,3a,75y,287.7h,104.46t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm38GZl6fGHhAXFB-80vNmA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). This mesh can also be ported into other development environments. I've tried Cura, 3d paint, and Unity (as shown in the images). If you decide to import into Unity, know that the file labeled pixil-frame-1.png is your materials file. You should be able to click and drag it onto each object to color it. The pixil-frame-1.png is also my color palette that I used to model the buildings. I attached it separately so you can make more blender files with the same colors. if you choose to.
Thanks for checking out my project!

Cityscape Teaset

  - 16.6k polys.

  - Low-Poly, High-Quality Model.

  - Clean Geometry and Topology.

  - High-quality 4k textures (png). Includes:

  - Diffuse.

  - Roughness.

  - PBR shading.

  - Optimized to be rendered realistically in Cycles [ray-tracing] and Eevee [real-time].

  - Provided in:

  - AutoCAD FBX 2018 (.fbx),

  - Stanford (.ply), 

  - X3D Extensible 3D (.x3d),

  - Stl (.stl),

  - Alembic (.abc),

  - AutoCAD DXF 2018 (.dxf),

  - Universal Scene Description (.usdc),

  - Native Blender 3.1 file (.blend). 

Note: All Renders were done in Ray-tracing Cycles.
